ja.title: TMPRSS2阻害剤の計算効率と薬効を分けて読む
ja.summary: 約29倍の計算費用改善は何を示すのか。TMPRSS2阻害剤研究の原著と解説を照合し、細胞までの裏付け、未評価の動物薬効、カモスタット臨床試験を区別する。
ja.seo_title: TMPRSS2阻害剤研究の計算効率と薬効の証拠
ja.seo_description: TMPRSS2阻害剤研究の29倍の計算費用改善、酵素・細胞試験、カモスタット臨床試験を検討。未評価と陰性、計算の終点と治療効果を分けて読む。

en.title: Separating computational efficiency from efficacy in TMPRSS2 inhibitor research
en.summary: A close reading separates a 29-fold computational-cost improvement, enzyme and cell evidence, unassessed animal efficacy, and clinical results for camostat.
en.seo_title: TMPRSS2: computational speed and evidence for efficacy
en.seo_description: Distinguish a 29-fold computational-cost improvement from enzyme, cellular and clinical evidence, without counting unassessed animal efficacy as failure.
